run_shadowgnn_training: run the shaDow training pipeline with a specified dataset and configuration file
run_shadowgnn_inference: run inference on a pre-trained shaDow model with a specified checkpoint directory
run_shadowgnn_postproc: run post-processing on a pre-trained shaDow model checkpoint with a configuration file
run_shadowgnn_complexity: compute inference complexity only without running actual inference on a shaDow model
run_shadowgnn_deterministic: run shaDow with a fixed seed and deterministic CUDA settings for reproducible experiments
